title: Sketch map of mountains, river and roads (VG 3)
summary: Hand-drawn viewgraph VG 3, marked for the standard brief: a river and main highway curving between mountains, with a sea road, central road, east road and west road. A legend marks old cities, new city boundaries and industry, super highways, rivers, mountains and an old mountain road.

title: Sketch map marked Padua (VG 5)
summary: Hand-drawn viewgraph VG 5, marked for the standard brief: an outline divided into zones, with cross-hatched areas at the top and along one edge and the word "Padua" written in a central zone.

title: Analyst assumption
summary: The analysts' working assumption: the target is in Italy, within a one-and-a-half-hour drive of Verona.

title: Session data, 18 December 1981 to 26 January 1982
summary: Dated viewgraphs listing what the sessions reported about the city and the site where the subject was held: a city ringed by water, a cathedral facing a traffic circle, a narrow street, entry on the second floor, the name Padua, and the subject handcuffed with three men in the building.

nodes.title: 18 Dec 81
nodes.summary: Data on city: surrounded by water, circled by a moat or river, with a raised highway with ramps on its edge. Data on site: a building across the river from the old city, in a low flat area, to the south or west of the city's southwest corner, with a drawing.

nodes.title: 21 Dec 81
nodes.summary: Data on city: the main road through town has a big traffic circle with a park in the centre, facing a large cathedral with many art forms in front and old stonework art forms across the street. Data on site: the target street is very narrow, almost like an alley.

nodes.title: 5 Jan 82
nodes.summary: Data on site: the primary entry is on the second floor.

nodes.title: 20 Jan 82
nodes.summary: Data on city: the name is Padua.

nodes.title: 26 Jan 82
nodes.summary: Data on site: the subject and three men are in the building; the men are in their early 30s and two have beards; the subject is handcuffed to a metal pipe or rail.

title: Summary
summary: Table of cuing methods and results by date. 18 Dec, name in sealed envelope: 26 responses, 8 correlated with target. 20 Dec and 21 Dec, photo in sealed envelope: 42/26 and 51/23. 5 Jan, photo: 38/9. 20 Jan, photo and name: 25/9. 26 Jan, directed to return to prior target area: 47/19.
